scan.tells: Lengths are fine: statement length averages 80.8 (true) vs 80.7 (false) across all 160 cards (80/80), and every section is within 5 characters. Explanations differ: false-card explanations are longer in 11 of 16 sections (1.1: 120 vs 108, 3.2: 123 vs 104, 4.5: 130 vs 112, 5.1: 108 vs 88, 8.1: 143 vs 123). That is only visible after answering. Wording tells: (1) Overreach adverbs and phrases mark false, 0 true vs 7 false: 'by itself' s1.1-06, s7.1-10; 'regardless' s6.1-05; 'beyond its managed set' s3.2-06; 'safely' s2.2-02; 'directly' s4.3-05; 'just' s4.4-03. (2) 'skip(s)' is false 3/3 (s2.2-06, s3.2-05, s4.4-06), and 'first' is false 3/4 (s2.1-06, s3.2-08, s4.4-06; true s4.3-07). (3) 'retains' is true 2/2 (s2.2-03, s2.2-07), both with the same 'state retains X ... after the block is removed' template. (4) 'after' leans true, 6T/3F. (5) 'can' is fine overall (26T/21F) but skews by section: in 7.1 every 'can' statement is false (s7.1-02, s7.1-07, s7.1-10, 0T/3F); in 1.1 'Terraform can manage ...' is true 4/6. (6) In 8.2, 'automatically' is true 2/3 (s8.2-04, s8.2-05; false s8.2-09). Requirement words are balanced: requires 3T/4F, by default 2T/1F. Recurring false templates: (a) 'X uses a value known only at apply' carries 3 false cards (s2.1-08, s4.1-04, s4.3-10; the one true card is s4.1-07), over the two-per-deck cap. (b) 'command X also does Y's job' carries 7 false cards (s3.1-04 init provisions, s3.1-07 validate checks APIs, s3.1-10 fmt repairs refs, s6.2-03 refresh-only restores objects, s8.2-09 drift detection applies, s3.2-06 destroy beyond managed set, s1.1-06 CLI watches Git), so 'the command stays in its lane' answers all of them. (c) 'a value crosses a module boundary implicitly' carries 6 false cards (s5.1-05, s5.1-06, s4.1-08, s6.1-06, s4.5-03, s4.4-03) against 2 true (s2.1-09, s5.1-04). (d) 'X can use an input variable' carries 2 false cards (s5.1-08, s6.1-07), at the cap. (e) 'X is stored/omitted in state' is mixed and fine. Name-giveaway or truism cards, all true, answerable from the flag or command name: s3.1-09 (fmt applies canonical layout), s4.2-03 (-var supplies a variable value), s3.2-07 (plan -destroy previews deletion), s3.2-01 (plan proposes create/update/delete), s3.1-01 (workflow reviews plan before apply), s1.1-02 (teams can review version-controlled config), s7.1-06 (state list prints addresses). That is 7 true cards a non-expert gets for free. Section 1.1 heuristic: 'Terraform is flexible or capable' scores 7/10 without knowledge, because s1.1-02, 03, 05, 07, 09 are true and s1.1-04, 10 are false limitation claims. s8.2-05 repeats 'HCP Terraform workspace' twice, which looks like padding on a true card.
